component.name: Discord Audio Bridge
component.summary: Stream one application's audio into a Discord voice channel

description.p: Discord Audio Bridge captures one application or output device, encodes it as Opus, and streams it into a Discord voice channel. A local browser control panel handles setup, destinations, sources, levels, mute, gain, bitrate, diagnostics, and logs.
Linux capture uses the desktop user's PipeWire session. A restricted remote dashboard can control the current stream from another device on the same LAN or personal Tailscale network.
Redesigns both control surfaces and strengthens capture reliability, tailnet identity, authentication, validation, and HTTP security.
Fixes installed control-panel asset discovery on Linux.
Adds command-free Linux desktop launching, single-instance attachment, and UI shutdown.
